scorer: scripts/prereg_spoc_317134140.py (dedicated scorer v1.3; full definitions in its docstring)
status_of_procedure: dated operationalization (2026-10-24) of the qualitative frozen test; the operational numbers below are post-freeze choices declared before any test-sector data
frozen_test: stacked depth at predicted phase in each of S108/S109/S110 should be ~185 +- 40 ppm; blind BLS of each sector should rank 0.5719 d near the top
events: every row of the prediction CSV for this sector is a candidate event; the in_science_orbit column is not used; eligibility is decided only by data coverage after preprocessing
clause_a: compatibility with the frozen depth plus positive-depth evidence: A_LOW if depth + 1.96 sigma < 145 ppm; A_HIGH if depth - 1.96 sigma > 225; A_CONSISTENT if depth +- 1.96 sigma overlaps [145, 225] and depth/sigma >= 2; else A_INCONCLUSIVE. INSUFFICIENT if < 10 eligible events, < 100 usable random shifts, or sigma is nonfinite or <= 0. 1.96 is nominal: the random-phase sigma is an empirical spread with no established 95 % coverage
clause_b: B_TOP3: one of the top 3 distinct peaks (> 1 % apart) of the original per-sector search within 0.1 % of 0.5718634 d; aliases reported, not counted; not run if clause A is INSUFFICIENT
sector_outcome: ORDERED, first rule that applies: (1) INSUFFICIENT if clause A is INSUFFICIENT; (2) FAIL if A_LOW, whatever clause B says; (3) PASS if A_CONSISTENT and B_TOP3; (4) PARTIAL if exactly one of A_CONSISTENT / B_TOP3 (includes A_HIGH + B_TOP3); (5) INCONCLUSIVE otherwise. Only PASS meets both frozen clauses; PARTIAL and INCONCLUSIVE are not confirmations; FAIL is adverse evidence under this measurement model, not proof of absence
scope: each of S108, S109, S110 scored and reported separately; no pooling; no replacement
secondary_readout: pooled S108-S110 depth = inverse-variance weighted mean of the per-sector clause-A depths, nominal 1.96-sigma interval vs [145, 225] ppm; never the outcome
preprocessing: registration prep() (public scripts/blind_seasons_317134140.py:12) with three stated differences: no candidate mask in detrending (blind search), PDCSAP_FLUX_ERR errors instead of a constant point-to-point error, clipping MAD over all retained points
toi_mask: TOI-2514.01 (P 6.3951381 d, T0 BTJD 2215.084143, 4.047 h) removed BEFORE detrending with wotan.transit_mask, full window 1.5 x 4.047 h
release_of_record: the eligible version listed at the FIRST RECORDED CHECK; an earlier, replaced delivery cannot be excluded (MAST lists the current version only). A metadata-only selection record (scripts/spoc_selection.py select) is made at the first check after a SPOC 2-min s_lc.fits of this TIC and sector is listed; exactly one candidate is required (else NONE, AMBIGUOUS or INCOMPLETE, kept and reported, nothing chosen). The selected dataURI is then downloaded (spoc_selection.py acquire), and validate_nonclock_inputs.py re-derives the selection from the saved rows and binds selection, acquisition, light curve and output
no_product_rule: cutoff 2027-03-26T04:15:00Z (sector end 2026-11-26 04:15:00 UTC + 120 days; inclusive). If a SELECTED selection record is made at or before the cutoff, the product may be acquired and scored at any later time. If no SELECTED record exists by the cutoff, the sector is UNAVAILABLE; no other product replaces it, and a later listing or delivery is a secondary readout only. UNAVAILABLE means that no SELECTED record was made by the cutoff, not that no archive product ever existed
monitoring_rule: Starting at the later of this lock's effective time (2026-10-24 23:40:31 UTC) and the sector end (2026-11-26 04:15:00 UTC), a metadata-only check (scripts/spoc_selection.py select) is performed and retained at least weekly until the first SELECTED record. If none exists, a final check is made within the 24 hours before the inclusive cutoff. Every check is retained, including NONE, AMBIGUOUS and INCOMPLETE, and the first eligible selected release is never replaced by a later one. This is periodic, not continuous, monitoring: a delivery between the final check and the cutoff could be missed.
advance_expectation: training sectors S6/S87/S98/S107: 1 PASS, 2 PARTIAL, 1 INCONCLUSIVE; mostly PARTIAL expected under a real signal (a conditional extrapolation, not a calibrated probability)
